goal: Allow wallets to test package acceptance and package RBF without inserting transactions into the mempool
Enables dry-running fee-bumping packages before broadcasting
reviewability: Waiting on the author to respond to questions about downstream demand
agreement: Support because pre-flight testing 1p1c packages is useful for wallets (ismaelsadeeq)
Nonblocking objection: ongoing RPC maintenance burden without confirmed downstream demand (dergoegge)

categories.name: mempool
why: P3 because it provides incremental dry-run test validation for fee-bumping packages
Does not resolve mempool DoS or transaction pinning issues

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it fills an API gap for package pre-flight checks without mutating mempool state
Adds a new endpoint to maintain with unconfirmed downstream demand
